description: AppsForBharat | 2–5 years of frontend engineering experience About the role At AppsForBharat, we’re looking for a Frontend Engineer to work on the frontend app of our core consumer products and build fast, accessible experiences for millions of devotees worldwide. You’ll work closely with Product and Design to improve how users discover, navigate, and transact on the web. With a large community of devotees using Sri Mandir every day, even small improvements can make a meaningful difference at scale. Strong proficiency in modern JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, React Hooks, and the Context API, plus experience with state management tools such as Redux. A strong understanding of SSR, SSG, caching, and bundle optimization, with the ability to explain the trade-offs behind your choices. Experience integrating REST APIs and third-party SDKs into production applications. Experience using tools such as Mixpanel or Google Analytics to understand user behavior and running A/B tests to improve conversion.
